value.rationale: The natural, explicitly defined K3n sandpile has a source-dependent dynamical invariant not determined by the known uniform recurrent-state count. Its rare-trigger law, two distinct macroscopic binomial wave bands, and exponentially smaller repeated-hub event provide a complete finite-size description with nontrivial separated scales, not just a routine restatement of a spanning tree count.
